name: notfair_plugin_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the notfair_plugin capability.

prompts.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompts.template: Optimize the following text for SEO based on target keywords: {query}
prompts.use_case: Enhancing AI-driven chatbots to provide SEO optimized content in multiple regions

prompts.name: geo_marketing_prompt
prompts.template: Create a marketing strategy tailored for the location {location_data} targeting {marketing_parameters}
prompts.use_case: Generating localized marketing campaigns for geographically targeted audiences

prompts.name: combined_seo_geo_prompt
prompts.template: Generate SEO optimized content considering the geographic details: {location_data} with marketing goals: {marketing_parameters}
prompts.use_case: Improving AI recommendations by incorporating geographical and SEO best practices
